recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future gateway representation work should be handled under current R6 or Extension Pack issues, not by reopening FHIR-31563 in core.
issue_request: FHIR-31563 asked how to reference gateway devices for sensors, requesting related-device structures on Device and DeviceDefinition while leaving parent relationships 0..1 and removing attached-to wording from Device.parent.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commits bc6378b7ac and 58b93a890b added Device.link, DeviceDefinition.link, and relation terminology; later FHIR-34310 commits completed the Device.parent hierarchy-only wording and FHIR-36828 commit 3932ce4be6 changed Device.link to Device.gateway.
additional_context: Current Device and DeviceDefinition are active build resources. DeviceDefinition.link remains active for related gateway definitions, Device.parent no longer says attached to, and later R6 decisions moved Device.gateway out of core to the FHIR Extension Pack device-gateway extension. Related audits for FHIR-34310, FHIR-34311, FHIR-36828, and FHIR-32565 already exist on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Reintroducing Device.link or active Device.gateway would conflict with later approved R6 decisions; the current source already preserves the DeviceDefinition side and points Device gateway instances to extensions.
